title: Controlled dose-response and sample-size diagnostic on the existing S24-7-M11 embedding cache
scope: Exploratory, label-informed constructed-mixture diagnostic on the already admitted 24,840-vector S24-7-M11 cache. Not a revision of S24-7-M11 or S24-7-M12, not independent confirmation of either, and not a temporal, business, performance or detection claim.
evidence_of_absence: this specification was written after the metadata-only census at artifacts/sprint-24/evidence/s24-7-m13-a01/census/census.json, which reads only the corpus manifest and the accepted M9 audit and records metadata_only=true, embeddings_read=false and outcomes_computed=false
no embedding array, prototype fit, E1 value or E2 value was computed before this file was written; the audit stage that reads the cache had not been implemented or executed
prior_exposure: The author had read the published S24-7-M11 and S24-7-M12 results before freezing this design, so no M13 quantity is a blind replication and none is independent confirmation.

designs.POOLED-CELL-PERIODS: union of the cell's audit low-burden and audit elevated periods; mixtures span periods and are not calendar windows
designs.LOW-PERIOD-SOURCE: audit low-burden periods only; retains the corpus's real low-burden faults and is the period-composition-controlled sensitivity

per_cell_exceptions.reason: 9 abnormal files cannot be placed inside the context headroom
6 abnormal files cannot be placed inside the context headroom

parameters.cells: the 12 accepted history x horizon cells of the accepted M9 audit pair rows; periods are read from that audit only
parameters.count_rounding: n_abnormal = floor(p * N + 0.5); n_ordinary = N - n_abnormal; realized n/N is reported at every dose

context_quota.stratum: robot|program from predicted_robot_idx and predicted_program_idx (label-blind, inherited M12 definition)
context_quota.allocation: capped largest-remainder apportionment of N over the capacities with caps equal to the capacities; deterministic sorted-key residual distribution by descending fractional remainder
context_quota.effect: every arm carries exactly the same robot|program counts; the fixed baseline arm and the zero-abnormal draw are disjoint by construction

abnormal_sequence.scope: one sequence per cell x design, independent of size and seed, length equal to the maximum planned n_abnormal of the design's grid at the largest supported size
abnormal_sequence.ordering: family-deficit proportional order: at each step the family with the largest (availability_share * step - used) receives the next file; ties broken by family name; files inside a family are ordered by sha256('S24-7-M13|sequence|' + file_id)
abnormal_sequence.headroom: a file is only accepted while its stratum has fewer selected abnormal files than min(quota_stratum, abnormal_availability_stratum); a blocked file is skipped permanently
abnormal_sequence.nesting: the abnormal files of dose p are the first n_abnormal(p) entries, so the abnormal sets are nested across doses and no family is silently dropped
abnormal_sequence.failure: if the sequence cannot reach n_max the whole unit abstains with ABSTAIN-ABNORMAL-HEADROOM

baseline.definition: one fixed all-ordinary arm of exactly N files carrying the frame context quota
baseline.selection: inside each stratum, ordinary files ordered by sha256('S24-7-M13|baseline|' + cell + '|' + design + '|' + N + '|' + stratum + '|' + file_id); the first quota_stratum files are the baseline
baseline.role: the fixed baseline distribution every dose is compared with; the baseline arm is disjoint from every dose draw

sampling.without_replacement: per repeat, files are drawn without replacement inside each (stratum, family) abnormal group and each ordinary stratum group
sampling.exclusion: ordinary candidate pools exclude the fixed baseline identities; abnormal files are never baseline files
sampling.rng: numpy.random.default_rng seeded with the first 16 hex digits of sha256 of the token 'S24-7-M13|draw|' + cell + '|' + N + '|' + design + '|' + format(dose, '.4f') + '|' + group descriptor
sampling.draw_construction: one random((repeats, group_size)) matrix per group, stable argsort, first k columns; identical draws are shared by all three encoder seeds and all K
sampling.invariants: exactly N identities per arm, no duplicate identity inside a draw, baseline and comparison arms disjoint, exact context counts

parameters.reference_fit: one fit per (history, encoder seed) on the accepted causal REFERENCE pool only, using the accepted fit_reference construction (median pairwise bandwidth, KMeans random_state 2407, n_init 10); no label, family, severity, context or evaluation mixture enters the fit

estimators.E1: accepted unbiased squared MMD at the reference bandwidth, computed with representation.sprint24_weekly_monthly_endpoints.mmd2_unbiased
estimators.E2_K4: occupancy total-variation distance at K=4 reference prototypes in exact equal-n quanta E2 = m / N
estimators.E2_K8: occupancy total-variation distance at K=8 reference prototypes in exact equal-n quanta E2 = m / N
estimators.E2_K16: occupancy total-variation distance at K=16 reference prototypes in exact equal-n quanta E2 = m / N

parameters.summaries: median, mean, q05, q95, min, max and the strictly-positive / exact-zero / strictly-negative repeat fractions; E2 additionally keeps its integer numerator
parameters.movement: each dose is described against the dose-0 baseline-vs-baseline band of the same unit and seed: null median, null q95, median excess, fraction of dose repeats above the null q95, and whether the dose median is above the null q95; dose 0 has no movement block
parameters.trends: tie-aware Spearman rank correlation between resolved dose and the per-dose median, plus counts of increasing / equal / decreasing steps, monotone-nondecreasing flag, the number of doses above the null q95 and the full dose curve
parameters.aggregates: per horizon x size x design x estimator only; per-seed rho counts, seed-median rho counts and all-three-seeds-agree counts; horizons, sizes and designs are never pooled and no seed or cell is selected as best

abstention.ABSTAIN-ORDINARY-CAPACITY: the ordinary support cannot supply two disjoint arms of size N
abstention.ABSTAIN-CONTEXT-QUOTA: no capped largest-remainder context quota exists
abstention.ABSTAIN-INSUFFICIENT-ABNORMAL: the maximum planned abnormal count exceeds the abnormal pool
abstention.ABSTAIN-ABNORMAL-HEADROOM: the abnormal pool cannot fill the maximum planned count inside the context headroom
abstention.policy: a refused unit keeps every planned dose x seed record with its reason and stays in the denominator; no replacement, reseeding or data generation is attempted

parameters.selection: no best dose, K, seed or size is selected; all planned cells, doses, seeds and K are published; unsupported curves remain explicitly undefined

analysis_order: verify the frozen specification digest, every pinned corpus/preflight/freeze/contract digest, the canonical contract binding and every accepted M11/M12 product digest
admit the retrieved cache through the accepted identity-strict public admission path and verify the cache digest-of-digests
fit one reference per (history, encoder seed) on the causal REFERENCE pool and assign prototypes to every admitted row
build the metadata census and refuse any drift from the recorded census statuses
build the frozen frame, abnormal sequence and fixed baseline arm per unit
draw the dose arms, verify count/composition/disjointness invariants
compute E1 and E2 repeat vectors for every unit x dose x seed
summarise doses, movement against the baseline-vs-baseline band, trends and aggregates; write the accounting

labels_policy.allowed: file labels construct the delivered dose and diagnose the realized composition
labels_policy.forbidden: labels, families, severities, anomalous fractions and context fields never enter a prototype fit, a bandwidth fit, a sampling rule, a context quota or any detector selection; no detector is fitted or selected

scope_exclusions: no data generation, capture, forward pass, encoder inference, training, bank or prototype refit, business-density scale, Phase C release or remote edit
no recapture fallback: missing or identity-drifted cache support is refused, never repaired
no p-value, significance test, success gate, confidence interval, performance, detection-accuracy, business-density or causal claim
no M11 or M12 product, result, cache byte, Main plan or foreign memory edit
outputs: artifacts/sprint-24/evidence/s24-7-m13-a01/spec/ (preserved original specification bytes and digest record)
artifacts/sprint-24/evidence/s24-7-m13-a01/amendments/ (separate timestamped amendment records; empty when none)

amendments.policy: the original specification bytes are never rewritten; any deviation discovered after outcomes are visible is a separate timestamped record declaring the frozen specification digest it amends, the stage of discovery, the reason and the sensitivity of the affected numbers
